about: AI newsreaders on air, taking turns by hour (hour % count). Owner approved five on 2026-10-08: Sana (anchor-1c, calm), Ayesha (anchor-5c, business), Zara (anchor-6c, dupatta), Hina (anchor-7c, office), Mehwish (anchor-8b, green). Each needs tools/news/presenters/clips/<id>.mp4, which build-news.yml downloads from channel-media news-move-<id>-raw.mp4.
